kingdomsIntro: One kingdom in each corner of the map. Your kingdom is wherever you settle, and you can move to another one later.

features.title: Build a character
features.body: Pick from eight races (four are free), six classes and eight playstyles. All three stack, and each free race has an Awakened form at level 100.

features.title: Earn money by playing
features.body: Twelve jobs, from Miner and Fisher to Alchemist and Guard. You join each one at its own NPC in Aldoria, the spawn world, and get paid as you play.

features.title: Run the dungeons
features.body: The Sanctum of Skulls and the Whispering Maze. You fight through stages of mobs to a boss, and the rewards get bigger the deeper you go.

features.title: Dying isn't the end
features.body: The world is set to Hard, but every death leaves a grave with your items where you fell. Get back within 7 days, because other players can break it and after 7 days it's gone.

features.title: Get fresh resources every week
features.body: The resource world resets every Saturday night at 11 PM Eastern with a new seed, so there is always untouched land to mine and the newest blocks to find.

features.title: Play on anything
features.body: Java players join by address. Console, mobile and Windows Bedrock players join through a friend account, with no address to type.

staffIntro: The people behind the server. You'll find us in game and in the Discord.
staffImageAlt: Five players standing together on a wooden bridge at night, lit by lanterns
staffImageCaption: A few of us in game
about: BrindleWood started as a family realm. We grew way too big for the 10 people a realm allows, so we became a server.
From there we slowly started roleplaying, which is when we decided on Kingdoms and built the spawn we have now.
We wanted somewhere we could have fun, use a ton of different things, and welcome people who were strangers into the fold as family.
